places.name: The Forge
places.description: Mara's blacksmith shop, inherited from her mother. A soot-blackened stone workshop with a roaring hearth, an anvil out front, and racks of horseshoes, hinges, and tools for sale. The ring of the hammer carries across town from sunrise to dusk.

places.name: The Docks
places.description: A weathered wooden pier on the water's edge where Finn fishes. Nets hang drying on the posts, a few small boats are tied up, and travelers passing through often stop here to rest and swap news.
